newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia needs discipline on IMF deal - premier.
newsitem.headline: Russia needs discipline on IMF deal - premier.

text.p: Russia needs more discipline to fulfil its obligations to the International Monetary Fund but Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin said on Friday that he hoped Russia would meet the terms of a credit deal.
"We will cultivate disciplinary measures," Chernomyrdin told a news conference after a meeting of leading politicians from countries surrounding the Black See.
"I hope we will fulfil the agreement. We are obliged to do so. We need it. We have not taught our people, our managers, how to act. We need to resolve the problem."

An IMF delegation left Moscow this week without recommending the release of the latest tranche of a three-year loan. A central bank statement said the IMF was worried about low Russian tax collection.
